title: LRKV residual head basis with Mirror codes
hypothesis: Beat native LRKV residual map bank by >=15% actual incremental serialized bytes with <=0.02 nat/token NLL loss and <=10% P95 decode latency overhead on >=4/5 fresh worlds
physical_object: native LRKV shared full-rank K/V maps with independently low-rank head residuals
mirror_coordinate: head/task/view m selecting source-trained residual basis factors with signed scaling and optional Givens
success_gate: 4/5 fresh worlds NLL difference <=+0.02 nat/token and median serialized bytes <=0.85 native byte-near LRKV, P95 decode <=1.10 and no head collapse
failure_gate: native byte-near LRKV/linear code dominates, NLL fails >=2/5, or storage/runtime overhead eliminates gains
boundaries: native LRKV already solves key/value sharing
